ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram showing a partial food web, what category is the barn owl?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a partial food web. In the “Producers and Consumers” section, the organism labeled “Barn Owl” appears near the top. Food-web arrows from other organisms point toward the barn owl, showing that it receives energy by eating other animals. Reasoning: In a food web, an animal that eats other animals is categorized as a predator. Therefore, the barn owl is a predator.
